objective: Add observable folder progress and safe user cancellation to InferencePage, including partial-result export and nonblocking MainWindow close coordination, while preserving single-image behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Folder mode presents an accessible progress indicator and Cancel action; initial state is zero/idle, Cancel is enabled only while a folder run can accept cancellation, and single-image mode retains its existing controls and semantics.

The page connects worker progress and cancelled signals to real bound QObject handlers before thread start and wires cancelled to thread.quit and worker.deleteLater alongside finished and failed without duplicate connections.

Progress displays discovered total and monotonically increasing completed/succeeded/failed counts from the delivered CP1 snapshots without estimating, polling, or reading worker-thread state directly.

Cancel requests are nonblocking and idempotent, update status to a concise cancelling state, disable further cancel clicks, and do not restore Run or inputs until the worker thread has fully cleaned up.

A cancelled terminal event displays the exact completed partial outcomes in deterministic order, reports processed and unprocessed counts distinctly from fatal failure, and retains that exact FolderInferenceResult for Phase 11 CSV/JSON export after cleanup.

Starting a new run clears stale progress, partial rows, cancellation status, and export source before work begins; rerun after cancellation can finish normally without a stale cancel flag, duplicate signals, rows, or exporter calls.
Fatal failure still clears results/export source, normal mixed completion remains Finished and exportable, and normal completion after all images is never displayed as Cancelled.

When MainWindow close is accepted during active folder inference, InferencePage requests cooperative cancellation and defers close until cancelled/finished/failed thread cleanup; active single-image inference retains natural-completion close behavior.
No GUI-thread wait, busy loop, QThread.terminate, mid-forward interruption, direct cross-thread widget mutation, or cancellation of CSV/JSON writes is introduced.

qtbot tests cover progress order and text/value state, cancel before/after progress, repeated cancel, partial export enablement, fatal/finished distinction, cleanup, rerun, close-triggered cancel, and unchanged single-image lifecycle using fake deterministic backends only.

MainWindow still owns exactly one InferencePage and its existing close orchestration API; no new tab, dialog workflow, public single-image API, artifact/schema, dependency, preview, drag-and-drop, or packaging feature is added.
claude_prompt: Implement only Phase 12 checkpoint 3 in exactly these allowed files: src/image_ai_studio/gui/inference_page.py, tests/gui/test_inference_page.py, and tests/gui/test_main_window.py. Add folder-only progress UI and a nonblocking idempotent Cancel action using CP2 signals/controller request. Connect bound handlers before thread start; wire cancelled through the same quit/deleteLater/cleanup lifecycle as finished/failed. Display exact progress, preserve the cancellation terminal's exact partial FolderInferenceResult for existing Phase 11 CSV/JSON export, distinguish processed/unprocessed cancellation from fatal failure, and clear stale state before rerun. On accepted MainWindow close during a folder run, request cooperative cancellation and wait only through existing asynchronous close coordination; do not change active single-image natural completion. Test with qtbot, deterministic events/fakes, and widget properties rather than screenshots or sleeps. Do not modify MainWindow production code unless the existing public coordination contract cannot support this; because main_window.py is not allowed, report a blocker instead of expanding scope. Do not modify core/controller/worker/exporter, artifacts, dependencies, pyproject, docs, other tests, goals, or config. Do not add wait/terminate/busy loops, automatic export, preview, drag-and-drop, packaging, or unrelated refactors. Do not weaken assertions. The implementation verifier must judge implementation and required tests only, not a future final harness result. Do not use Bash or Git, do not run tests, and do not commit or push.
estimated_scope: Focused folder UX and close-coordination slice in one page plus two existing GUI test modules, approximately 320-520 changed lines combined.
